title: Galveston Party Boats
specs: Innovators and original operators of catamaran fishing vessels in Galveston
Child age 12 & under for Bay and Jetty trip; ages 7-12 for Deep Sea 8 and 12 hour trips
Must be 16 years or older for 30-hour trip
includes: Rod, reel, squid and stringer provided

addons.name: Children four years and under - rider

blurb: Guests fish for various species including red and black drum, snapper, and tuna on different duration trips ranging from 4 to 30 hours. Trips include rod, reel, squid, and stringer provided. Trips operate weather permitting and require reservations, especially in peak season.
extraNote: Three day notice required to avoid deposit forfeiture for most trips; seven days for 30- and 56-hour trips · All trips weather permitting and depend on prior bookings
